# ONLYOFFICE Docs: Office API — Spreadsheet API

> A spreadsheet document has a more simple structure than that of a document, most of the spreadsheet elements are nested within the worksheet element with all the other elements placed on it.

Links below point to the Markdown version of each page. This file covers one part of the [section index](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/llms.txt); for the other sections of this documentation, see the [index](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/llms.txt).

## Overview

- [Spreadsheet API](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api.md): A spreadsheet document has a more simple structure than that of a document, most of the spreadsheet elements are nested within the worksheet element with all the other elements placed on it.

## Api

- [Api](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api.md): The main class of the Spreadsheet API. Use it to get the active workbook, worksheets, ranges, and the current selection, and to add worksheets, defined names, and custom functions.
- [Api.AddComment](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/AddComment.md): Adds a comment to the current workbook.
- [Api.AddCustomFunction](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/AddCustomFunction.md): Creates a new custom function.
- [Api.AddCustomFunctionLibrary](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/AddCustomFunctionLibrary.md): Registers a new custom functions library (see the SetCustomFunctions plugin method).
- [Api.AddDefName](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/AddDefName.md): Adds a new name to a range of cells.
- [Api.AddSheet](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/AddSheet.md): Creates a new worksheet.
- [Api.Calculate](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/Calculate.md): Recalculates the cells that need recalculation (changed, added or volatile) across the active workbook, similar to Application.Calculate in VBA. Forces the recalc that is otherwise deferred until a macro finishes, so up-to-date formula results can be read within the same macro.
- [Api.CentimetersToPoints](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/CentimetersToPoints.md): Converts centimeters to points.
- [Api.ClearCustomFunctions](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/ClearCustomFunctions.md): Clears all custom functions.
- [Api.Color](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/Color.md): Creates an ApiColor from a universal input.
- [Api.CreateBlipFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/CreateBlipFill.md): Creates a blip fill to apply to the object using the selected image as the object background.
- [Api.CreateBullet](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/CreateBullet.md): Creates a bullet for a paragraph with the character or symbol specified with the sSymbol parameter.
- [Api.CreateColorByName](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/CreateColorByName.md): Creates a color selecting it from one of the available color presets.
- [Api.CreateColorFromRGB](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/CreateColorFromRGB.md): Creates an RGB color setting the appropriate values for the red, green and blue color components.
- [Api.CreateCustomGeometry](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/CreateCustomGeometry.md): Creates a new custom geometry.
- [Api.CreateGradientStop](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/CreateGradientStop.md): Creates a gradient stop used for different types of gradients.
- [Api.CreateLinearGradientFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/CreateLinearGradientFill.md): Creates a linear gradient fill to apply to the object using the selected linear gradient as the object background.
- [Api.CreateMath](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/CreateMath.md): Creates a math equation from a linear text string. The resulting object can be inserted into a paragraph the same way as a run (e.g. via ApiParagraph#AddElement or ApiParagraph#Push).
- [Api.CreateNewHistoryPoint](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/CreateNewHistoryPoint.md): Creates a new history point.
- [Api.CreateNoFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/CreateNoFill.md): Creates no fill and removes the fill from the element.
- [Api.CreateNumbering](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/CreateNumbering.md): Creates a bullet for a paragraph with the numbering character or symbol specified with the numType parameter.
- [Api.CreateParagraph](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/CreateParagraph.md): Creates a new paragraph.
- [Api.CreatePatternFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/CreatePatternFill.md): Creates a pattern fill to apply to the object using the selected pattern as the object background.
- [Api.CreatePresetColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/CreatePresetColor.md): Creates a color selecting it from one of the available color presets.
- [Api.CreatePresetGeometry](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/CreatePresetGeometry.md): Creates a geometry using one of the available preset shapes.
- [Api.CreateRGBColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/CreateRGBColor.md): Creates an RGB color setting the appropriate values for the red, green and blue color components.
- [Api.CreateRadialGradientFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/CreateRadialGradientFill.md): Creates a radial gradient fill to apply to the object using the selected radial gradient as the object background.
- [Api.CreateRun](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/CreateRun.md): Creates a new smaller text block to be inserted to the current paragraph or table.
- [Api.CreateSchemeColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/CreateSchemeColor.md): Creates a complex color scheme selecting from one of the available schemes.
- [Api.CreateShadow](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/CreateShadow.md): Creates a shadow which can be applied to a graphic object.
- [Api.CreateShd](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/CreateShd.md): Creates the shading which can be applied to text, a paragraph, a table or a table cell.
- [Api.CreateSolidFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/CreateSolidFill.md): Creates a solid fill to apply to the object using a selected solid color as the object background.
- [Api.CreateStroke](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/CreateStroke.md): Creates a stroke adding shadows to the element.
- [Api.CreateTextPr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/CreateTextPr.md): Creates the empty text properties.
- [Api.EmusToMillimeters](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/EmusToMillimeters.md): Converts English Metric Units (EMUs) to millimeters.
- [Api.EmusToPoints](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/EmusToPoints.md): Converts EMUs (English Metric Units) to points.
- [Api.Format](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/Format.md): Returns a class formatted according to the instructions contained in the format expression.
- [Api.GetActiveSheet](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/GetActiveSheet.md): Returns an object that represents the active sheet.
- [Api.GetActiveWorkbook](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/GetActiveWorkbook.md): Returns an object that represents the active workbook.
- [Api.GetAllComments](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/GetAllComments.md): Returns all comments from the current workbook including comments from all worksheets.
- [Api.GetAllPivotTables](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/GetAllPivotTables.md): Returns all pivot tables.
- [Api.GetByInternalId](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/GetByInternalId.md): Returns an object by its internal ID.
- [Api.GetCommentById](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/GetCommentById.md): Returns a comment from the current document by its ID.
- [Api.GetComments](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/GetComments.md): Returns all comments related to the whole workbook.
- [Api.GetCore](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/GetCore.md): Returns the core properties interface for the workbook.
- [Api.GetCustomProperties](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/GetCustomProperties.md): Returns the workbook custom properties.
- [Api.GetDefName](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/GetDefName.md): Returns the ApiName object by the range name.
- [Api.GetDefNames](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/GetDefNames.md): Returns an array of all ApiName objects defined in the workbook, across all scopes (workbook-level and sheet-level).
- [Api.GetDocumentInfo](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/GetDocumentInfo.md): Returns the document information:
- [Api.GetFreezePanesType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/GetFreezePanesType.md): Returns the freeze panes type.
- [Api.GetFullName](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/GetFullName.md): Returns the full name of the currently opened file.
- [Api.GetLocale](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/GetLocale.md): Returns the current locale ID.
- [Api.GetMailMergeData](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/GetMailMergeData.md): Returns the mail merge data.
- [Api.GetPivotByName](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/GetPivotByName.md): Returns a pivot table by its name, or null if it does not exist.
- [Api.GetRange](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/GetRange.md): Returns the ApiRange object by the range reference.
- [Api.GetReferenceStyle](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/GetReferenceStyle.md): Returns the cell reference style.
- [Api.GetSelection](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/GetSelection.md): Returns an object that represents the selected range.
- [Api.GetSheet](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/GetSheet.md): Returns an object that represents a sheet.
- [Api.GetSheets](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/GetSheets.md): Returns a sheet collection that represents all the sheets in the active workbook.
- [Api.GetThemesColors](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/GetThemesColors.md): Returns a list of all the available theme colors for the spreadsheet.
- [Api.GetWorksheetFunction](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/GetWorksheetFunction.md): Returns the ApiWorksheetFunction object.
- [Api.HexColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/HexColor.md): Creates a color from a HEX string.
- [Api.InchesToPoints](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/InchesToPoints.md): Converts inches to points.
- [Api.InsertPivotExistingWorksheet](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/InsertPivotExistingWorksheet.md): Inserts the specified pivot table into an existing worksheet.
- [Api.InsertPivotNewWorksheet](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/InsertPivotNewWorksheet.md): Inserts the specified pivot table into a new worksheet.
- [Api.Intersect](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/Intersect.md): Returns the ApiRange object that represents the rectangular intersection of two or more ranges.
- [Api.LinesToPoints](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/LinesToPoints.md): Converts lines to points (1 line = 12 points).
- [Api.MergeShapes](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/MergeShapes.md): Merges an array of drawings into new shapes. The resulting shapes take the formatting of the first drawing in the array.
- [Api.MillimetersToEmus](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/MillimetersToEmus.md): Converts millimeters to English Metric Units (EMUs).
- [Api.MillimetersToPixels](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/MillimetersToPixels.md): Converts millimeters to pixels.
- [Api.MillimetersToPoints](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/MillimetersToPoints.md): Converts millimeters to points.
- [Api.PicasToPoints](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/PicasToPoints.md): Converts picas to points.
- [Api.PixelsToEmus](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/PixelsToEmus.md): Converts pixels to EMUs (English Metric Units).
- [Api.PixelsToPoints](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/PixelsToPoints.md): Converts pixels to points.
- [Api.PointsToCentimeters](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/PointsToCentimeters.md): Converts points to centimeters.
- [Api.PointsToEmus](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/PointsToEmus.md): Converts points to EMUs (English Metric Units).
- [Api.PointsToInches](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/PointsToInches.md): Converts points to inches.
- [Api.PointsToLines](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/PointsToLines.md): Converts points to lines (1 line = 12 points).
- [Api.PointsToMillimeters](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/PointsToMillimeters.md): Converts points to millimeters.
- [Api.PointsToPicas](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/PointsToPicas.md): Converts points to picas (1 pica = 12 points).
- [Api.PointsToPixels](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/PointsToPixels.md): Converts points to pixels.
- [Api.PointsToTwips](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/PointsToTwips.md): Converts points to twips.
- [Api.RGB](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/RGB.md): Creates an RGB color from red, green and blue components.
- [Api.RGBA](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/RGBA.md): Creates an RGBA color from red, green, blue and alpha components.
- [Api.RecalculateAllFormulas](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/RecalculateAllFormulas.md): Recalculates all formulas in the active workbook.
- [Api.Redraw](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/Redraw.md): Redraws the editor screen, making the changes already made by a macro visible without waiting for it to finish. Observable from asynchronous code only. Repaints without recalculating: call Api#Calculate first if formula results must be up to date.
- [Api.RefreshAllPivots](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/RefreshAllPivots.md): Refreshes all pivot tables.
- [Api.RemoveCustomFunction](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/RemoveCustomFunction.md): Removes a custom function.
- [Api.ReplaceTextSmart](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/ReplaceTextSmart.md): Replaces each paragraph (or text in cell) in the select with the corresponding text from an array of strings.
- [Api.Save](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/Save.md): Saves changes to the specified document.
- [Api.SetFreezePanesType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/SetFreezePanesType.md): Sets a type to the freeze panes.
- [Api.SetLocale](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/SetLocale.md): Sets a locale to the document.
- [Api.SetReferenceStyle](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/SetReferenceStyle.md): Sets the cell reference style.
- [Api.SetThemeColors](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/SetThemeColors.md): Sets the theme colors to the current spreadsheet.
- [Api.ThemeColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/ThemeColor.md): Creates a theme color.
- [Api.TwipsToPoints](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/TwipsToPoints.md): Converts twips to points.
- [Api.attachEvent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/attachEvent.md): Subscribes to the specified event and calls the callback function when the event fires.
- [Api.detachEvent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Api/Methods/detachEvent.md): Unsubscribes from the specified event.

## ApiAboveAverage

- [ApiAboveAverage](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiAboveAverage.md): Class representing an above average conditional formatting rule.
- [ApiAboveAverage.Delete](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiAboveAverage/Methods/Delete.md): Deletes the above average conditional formatting rule.
- [ApiAboveAverage.GetAboveBelow](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiAboveAverage/Methods/GetAboveBelow.md): Returns whether the rule is configured to detect values above or below the average.
- [ApiAboveAverage.GetAppliesTo](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiAboveAverage/Methods/GetAppliesTo.md): Returns the range of cells to which the current conditional formatting rule applies.
- [ApiAboveAverage.GetDateOperator](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiAboveAverage/Methods/GetDateOperator.md): Returns the date operator for time period conditions.
- [ApiAboveAverage.GetFillColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiAboveAverage/Methods/GetFillColor.md): Returns the background color for the format condition.
- [ApiAboveAverage.GetFont](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiAboveAverage/Methods/GetFont.md): Returns the font applied by the current format condition.
- [ApiAboveAverage.GetFormula1](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiAboveAverage/Methods/GetFormula1.md): Returns the first formula used by the current conditional formatting rule.
- [ApiAboveAverage.GetFormula2](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiAboveAverage/Methods/GetFormula2.md): Returns the second formula used by the current conditional formatting rule.
- [ApiAboveAverage.GetNumStdDev](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiAboveAverage/Methods/GetNumStdDev.md): Returns the number of standard deviations from the average.
- [ApiAboveAverage.GetNumberFormat](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiAboveAverage/Methods/GetNumberFormat.md): Returns the number format applied to a cell when the conditional formatting rule evaluates to true.
- [ApiAboveAverage.GetOperator](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiAboveAverage/Methods/GetOperator.md): Returns the format condition operator.
- [ApiAboveAverage.GetPTCondition](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiAboveAverage/Methods/GetPTCondition.md): Returns the pivot table condition object.
- [ApiAboveAverage.GetParent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiAboveAverage/Methods/GetParent.md): Returns the parent range object of the current format condition.
- [ApiAboveAverage.GetPriority](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiAboveAverage/Methods/GetPriority.md): Returns the priority value of the conditional formatting rule.
- [ApiAboveAverage.GetScopeType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiAboveAverage/Methods/GetScopeType.md): Returns the scope type of the conditional formatting rule.
- [ApiAboveAverage.GetStopIfTrue](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiAboveAverage/Methods/GetStopIfTrue.md): Returns whether the editor will stop evaluating additional formatting rules if this rule evaluates to true.
- [ApiAboveAverage.GetText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiAboveAverage/Methods/GetText.md): Returns the text value used in text-based conditional formatting rules.
- [ApiAboveAverage.GetTextOperator](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiAboveAverage/Methods/GetTextOperator.md): Returns the text operator for text-based conditional formatting rules.
- [ApiAboveAverage.GetType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiAboveAverage/Methods/GetType.md): Returns the type of the above average conditional formatting rule.
- [ApiAboveAverage.Modify](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiAboveAverage/Methods/Modify.md): Modifies the current format condition with the specified parameters.
- [ApiAboveAverage.ModifyAppliesToRange](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiAboveAverage/Methods/ModifyAppliesToRange.md): Modifies the cell range to which the current conditional formatting rule applies.
- [ApiAboveAverage.SetAboveBelow](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiAboveAverage/Methods/SetAboveBelow.md): Sets whether the rule targets values above or below the average.
- [ApiAboveAverage.SetBorders](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiAboveAverage/Methods/SetBorders.md): Sets the border style for the conditional formatting rule.
- [ApiAboveAverage.SetDateOperator](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiAboveAverage/Methods/SetDateOperator.md): Sets the date operator for time period conditions.
- [ApiAboveAverage.SetFillColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiAboveAverage/Methods/SetFillColor.md): Sets the background color to the format condition with the previously created color object.
- [ApiAboveAverage.SetFirstPriority](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiAboveAverage/Methods/SetFirstPriority.md): Sets the priority value for the current conditional formatting rule to "1" so that it will be evaluated before all other rules on the worksheet.
- [ApiAboveAverage.SetLastPriority](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiAboveAverage/Methods/SetLastPriority.md): Sets the evaluation order for the current conditional formatting rule so it is evaluated after all other rules on the worksheet.
- [ApiAboveAverage.SetNumStdDev](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiAboveAverage/Methods/SetNumStdDev.md): Sets the number of standard deviations from the average.
- [ApiAboveAverage.SetNumberFormat](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiAboveAverage/Methods/SetNumberFormat.md): Sets the number format applied to a cell when the conditional formatting rule evaluates to true.
- [ApiAboveAverage.SetPriority](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiAboveAverage/Methods/SetPriority.md): Sets the priority value for the conditional formatting rule.
- [ApiAboveAverage.SetScopeType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiAboveAverage/Methods/SetScopeType.md): Sets the scope type for the conditional formatting rule.
- [ApiAboveAverage.SetStopIfTrue](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiAboveAverage/Methods/SetStopIfTrue.md): Sets whether the editor will stop evaluating additional formatting rules if this rule evaluates to true.
- [ApiAboveAverage.SetText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiAboveAverage/Methods/SetText.md): Sets the text value used in text-based conditional formatting rules.
- [ApiAboveAverage.SetTextOperator](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiAboveAverage/Methods/SetTextOperator.md): Sets the text operator for text-based conditional formatting rules.

- [ApiColorScale.GetOperator](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiColorScale/Methods/GetOperator.md): Returns the format condition operator.

- [ApiColorScale.GetScopeType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiColorScale/Methods/GetScopeType.md): Returns the scope type of the conditional formatting rule.
- [ApiColorScale.GetStopIfTrue](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiColorScale/Methods/GetStopIfTrue.md): Returns whether the editor will stop evaluating additional formatting rules if this rule evaluates to true. This rule type cannot stop the evaluation, so the value can be changed only by opening a file where it is set.
- [ApiColorScale.GetText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiColorScale/Methods/GetText.md): Returns the text value used in text-based conditional formatting rules.

- [ApiColorScale.SetFirstPriority](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiColorScale/Methods/SetFirstPriority.md): Sets the priority value for the current conditional formatting rule to "1" so that it will be evaluated before all other rules on the worksheet.
- [ApiColorScale.SetLastPriority](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiColorScale/Methods/SetLastPriority.md): Sets the evaluation order for the current conditional formatting rule so it is evaluated after all other rules on the worksheet.

- [ApiColorScale.SetScopeType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiColorScale/Methods/SetScopeType.md): Sets the scope type for the conditional formatting rule.

## ApiDocumentContent

- [ApiDocumentContent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiDocumentContent.md): Class representing a container for paragraphs and tables.
- [ApiDocumentContent.AddElement](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiDocumentContent/Methods/AddElement.md): Adds a paragraph or a table or a blockLvl content control using its position in the document content.
- [ApiDocumentContent.AddText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiDocumentContent/Methods/AddText.md): Appends the specified text to the end of the document content.
- [ApiDocumentContent.GetAllParagraphs](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiDocumentContent/Methods/GetAllParagraphs.md): Returns an array of all paragraphs from the current document content.
- [ApiDocumentContent.GetClassType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiDocumentContent/Methods/GetClassType.md): Returns a type of the ApiDocumentContent class.
- [ApiDocumentContent.GetCurrentParagraph](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiDocumentContent/Methods/GetCurrentParagraph.md): Returns the current paragraph where the cursor is located.
- [ApiDocumentContent.GetCurrentRun](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiDocumentContent/Methods/GetCurrentRun.md): Returns the current run where the cursor is located.
- [ApiDocumentContent.GetElement](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiDocumentContent/Methods/GetElement.md): Returns an element by its position in the document.
- [ApiDocumentContent.GetElementsCount](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiDocumentContent/Methods/GetElementsCount.md): Returns a number of elements in the current document.
- [ApiDocumentContent.GetInternalId](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiDocumentContent/Methods/GetInternalId.md): Returns an internal ID of the current document content.
- [ApiDocumentContent.GetText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiDocumentContent/Methods/GetText.md): Returns the inner text of the current document content object.
- [ApiDocumentContent.GetTextRange](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiDocumentContent/Methods/GetTextRange.md): Returns an ApiTextRange object that represents the part of the text contained in the current document content.
- [ApiDocumentContent.Push](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiDocumentContent/Methods/Push.md): Pushes a paragraph or a table to actually add it to the document.
- [ApiDocumentContent.RemoveAllElements](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiDocumentContent/Methods/RemoveAllElements.md): Removes all the elements from the current document or from the current document element.
- [ApiDocumentContent.RemoveElement](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiDocumentContent/Methods/RemoveElement.md): Removes an element using the position specified.
- [ApiDocumentContent.SetText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiDocumentContent/Methods/SetText.md): Replaces all content of the current document content object with the specified text, preserving the formatting of the first paragraph.

- [ApiIconSetCondition.SetDateOperator](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiIconSetCondition/Methods/SetDateOperator.md): Sets the date operator for time period conditions.

- [ApiIconSetCondition.SetFirstPriority](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiIconSetCondition/Methods/SetFirstPriority.md): Sets the priority value for the current conditional formatting rule to "1" so that it will be evaluated before all other rules on the worksheet.
- [ApiIconSetCondition.SetIconSet](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiIconSetCondition/Methods/SetIconSet.md): Sets the icon set type for the conditional formatting rule.
- [ApiIconSetCondition.SetLastPriority](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiIconSetCondition/Methods/SetLastPriority.md): Sets the evaluation order for the current conditional formatting rule so it is evaluated after all other rules on the worksheet.
- [ApiIconSetCondition.SetNumberFormat](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiIconSetCondition/Methods/SetNumberFormat.md): Sets the number format applied to a cell when the conditional formatting rule evaluates to true.
- [ApiIconSetCondition.SetPercentileValues](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiIconSetCondition/Methods/SetPercentileValues.md): Specifies whether the thresholds for the icon set conditional format are determined by using percentiles.
- [ApiIconSetCondition.SetPriority](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiIconSetCondition/Methods/SetPriority.md): Sets the priority value for the conditional formatting rule.
- [ApiIconSetCondition.SetReverseOrder](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiIconSetCondition/Methods/SetReverseOrder.md): Specifies whether the icon order in the icon set rule is reversed.
- [ApiIconSetCondition.SetScopeType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiIconSetCondition/Methods/SetScopeType.md): Sets the scope type for the conditional formatting rule.
- [ApiIconSetCondition.SetShowIconOnly](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiIconSetCondition/Methods/SetShowIconOnly.md): Specifies whether to display only icons in the icon set rule (without cell values).
- [ApiIconSetCondition.SetStopIfTrue](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiIconSetCondition/Methods/SetStopIfTrue.md): Sets whether the editor will stop evaluating additional formatting rules if this rule evaluates to true.
- [ApiIconSetCondition.SetText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiIconSetCondition/Methods/SetText.md): Sets the text value used in text-based conditional formatting rules.
- [ApiIconSetCondition.SetTextOperator](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiIconSetCondition/Methods/SetTextOperator.md): Sets the text operator for text-based conditional formatting rules.

The ListObject is considered active when the active cell is within the range of the ListObject.

- [ApiName.GetName](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiName/Methods/GetName.md): Returns a type of the ApiName class.

## ApiPageSetup

- [ApiPageSetup](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPageSetup.md): Class representing the page setup (print layout) of a worksheet.
- [ApiPageSetup.GetAlignMarginsHeaderFooter](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPageSetup/Methods/GetAlignMarginsHeaderFooter.md): Returns whether the header and footer margins are aligned with the page margins.
- [ApiPageSetup.GetBottomMargin](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPageSetup/Methods/GetBottomMargin.md): Returns the size of the bottom margin.
- [ApiPageSetup.GetCenterFooter](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPageSetup/Methods/GetCenterFooter.md): Returns the center part of the footer used when the worksheet is printed.
- [ApiPageSetup.GetCenterHeader](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPageSetup/Methods/GetCenterHeader.md): Returns the center part of the header used when the worksheet is printed.
- [ApiPageSetup.GetCenterHorizontally](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPageSetup/Methods/GetCenterHorizontally.md): Returns whether the worksheet is centered horizontally on the page when printed.
- [ApiPageSetup.GetCenterVertically](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPageSetup/Methods/GetCenterVertically.md): Returns whether the worksheet is centered vertically on the page when printed.
- [ApiPageSetup.GetDifferentFirstPageHeaderFooter](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPageSetup/Methods/GetDifferentFirstPageHeaderFooter.md): Returns whether a different header and footer is used on the first printed page.
- [ApiPageSetup.GetEvenPage](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPageSetup/Methods/GetEvenPage.md): Returns the header and footer of the even pages of the worksheet. The returned object is meaningful when ApiPageSetup#GetOddAndEvenPagesHeaderFooter is enabled.
- [ApiPageSetup.GetFirstPage](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPageSetup/Methods/GetFirstPage.md): Returns the header and footer of the first page of the worksheet. The returned object is meaningful when ApiPageSetup#GetDifferentFirstPageHeaderFooter is enabled.
- [ApiPageSetup.GetFirstPageNumber](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPageSetup/Methods/GetFirstPageNumber.md): Returns the first page number used when the worksheet is printed. Returns null when the page numbering is automatic.
- [ApiPageSetup.GetFitToPagesTall](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPageSetup/Methods/GetFitToPagesTall.md): Returns the number of pages tall the worksheet is scaled to when printed (0 means automatic).
- [ApiPageSetup.GetFitToPagesWide](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPageSetup/Methods/GetFitToPagesWide.md): Returns the number of pages wide the worksheet is scaled to when printed (0 means automatic).
- [ApiPageSetup.GetFooterMargin](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPageSetup/Methods/GetFooterMargin.md): Returns the distance from the bottom of the page to the footer.
- [ApiPageSetup.GetHeaderMargin](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPageSetup/Methods/GetHeaderMargin.md): Returns the distance from the top of the page to the header.
- [ApiPageSetup.GetLeftFooter](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPageSetup/Methods/GetLeftFooter.md): Returns the left part of the footer used when the worksheet is printed.
- [ApiPageSetup.GetLeftHeader](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPageSetup/Methods/GetLeftHeader.md): Returns the left part of the header used when the worksheet is printed.
- [ApiPageSetup.GetLeftMargin](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPageSetup/Methods/GetLeftMargin.md): Returns the size of the left margin.
- [ApiPageSetup.GetOddAndEvenPagesHeaderFooter](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPageSetup/Methods/GetOddAndEvenPagesHeaderFooter.md): Returns whether different headers and footers are used on odd and even printed pages.
- [ApiPageSetup.GetOrientation](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPageSetup/Methods/GetOrientation.md): Returns the page orientation used when the worksheet is printed.
- [ApiPageSetup.GetPaperSize](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPageSetup/Methods/GetPaperSize.md): Returns the paper size used when the worksheet is printed.
- [ApiPageSetup.GetParent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPageSetup/Methods/GetParent.md): Returns the worksheet that owns this page setup.
- [ApiPageSetup.GetPrintArea](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPageSetup/Methods/GetPrintArea.md): Returns the range to be printed (the print area) as a string, or an empty string when the whole sheet is printed.
- [ApiPageSetup.GetPrintGridlines](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPageSetup/Methods/GetPrintGridlines.md): Returns whether cell gridlines are printed with the worksheet.
- [ApiPageSetup.GetPrintHeadings](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPageSetup/Methods/GetPrintHeadings.md): Returns whether row and column headings are printed with the worksheet.
- [ApiPageSetup.GetPrintTitleColumns](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPageSetup/Methods/GetPrintTitleColumns.md): Returns the columns that are repeated at the left of each printed page, or an empty string if none.

- [ApiPageSetup.GetRightFooter](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPageSetup/Methods/GetRightFooter.md): Returns the right part of the footer used when the worksheet is printed.

- [ApiPageSetup.GetRightMargin](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPageSetup/Methods/GetRightMargin.md): Returns the size of the right margin.

Setting this property turns on the "fit to page" mode.

- [ApiPageSetup.SetPaperSize](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPageSetup/Methods/SetPaperSize.md): Sets the paper size used when the worksheet is printed.
- [ApiPageSetup.SetPrintArea](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPageSetup/Methods/SetPrintArea.md): Sets the range to be printed (the print area). Pass an empty string to clear it and print the whole sheet.
- [ApiPageSetup.SetPrintGridlines](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPageSetup/Methods/SetPrintGridlines.md): Sets whether cell gridlines are printed with the worksheet.

- [ApiPageSetup.SetPrintTitleRows](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPageSetup/Methods/SetPrintTitleRows.md): Sets the rows that are repeated at the top of each printed page. Pass an empty string to clear them.
- [ApiPageSetup.SetRightFooter](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPageSetup/Methods/SetRightFooter.md): Sets the right part of the footer used when the worksheet is printed.
- [ApiPageSetup.SetRightHeader](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPageSetup/Methods/SetRightHeader.md): Sets the right part of the header used when the worksheet is printed.
- [ApiPageSetup.SetRightMargin](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPageSetup/Methods/SetRightMargin.md): Sets the size of the right margin.
- [ApiPageSetup.SetScaleWithDocHeaderFooter](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPageSetup/Methods/SetScaleWithDocHeaderFooter.md): Sets whether the header and footer are scaled with the document when it is scaled for printing.
- [ApiPageSetup.SetTopMargin](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPageSetup/Methods/SetTopMargin.md): Sets the size of the top margin.
- [ApiPageSetup.SetZoom](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPageSetup/Methods/SetZoom.md): Sets the scaling factor (in percent) used when the worksheet is printed. Setting this property turns off the "fit to page" mode.

The paragraph must be attached to the document before calling this method.

- [ApiParagraph.SetTabs](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiParagraph/Methods/SetTabs.md): Specifies a sequence of custom tab stops which will be used for any tab characters in the current paragraph.

## ApiPath

- [ApiPath](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPath.md): Class representing a path in geometry.
- [ApiPath.ArcTo](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPath/Methods/ArcTo.md): Draws an arc from the current point using the specified width and height radii, start angle, and sweep angle.
- [ApiPath.Close](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPath/Methods/Close.md): Closes the current path.
- [ApiPath.CubicBezTo](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPath/Methods/CubicBezTo.md): Draws a cubic Bezier curve from the current point to the specified end point using two control points.
- [ApiPath.GetCommand](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPath/Methods/GetCommand.md): Returns a specific path command by its index.
- [ApiPath.GetCommandCount](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPath/Methods/GetCommandCount.md): Returns the number of commands for the current path.
- [ApiPath.GetCommands](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPath/Methods/GetCommands.md): Returns all commands of the current path.
- [ApiPath.GetFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPath/Methods/GetFill.md): Returns the fill type of the current path.
- [ApiPath.GetHeight](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPath/Methods/GetHeight.md): Returns the height of the current path.
- [ApiPath.GetStroke](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPath/Methods/GetStroke.md): Returns true if the current path is stroked, otherwise false.
- [ApiPath.GetWidth](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPath/Methods/GetWidth.md): Returns the width of the current path.
- [ApiPath.LineTo](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPath/Methods/LineTo.md): Draws a line from the current point to the specified coordinates.
- [ApiPath.MoveTo](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPath/Methods/MoveTo.md): Moves the current path to the specified coordinates.
- [ApiPath.QuadBezTo](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPath/Methods/QuadBezTo.md): Draws a quadratic Bezier curve from the current point to the specified end point using a control point.
- [ApiPath.SetFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPath/Methods/SetFill.md): Sets the fill type to the current path.
- [ApiPath.SetHeight](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPath/Methods/SetHeight.md): Sets the height to the current path.
- [ApiPath.SetStroke](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPath/Methods/SetStroke.md): Sets whether the current path is stroked.
- [ApiPath.SetWidth](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPath/Methods/SetWidth.md): Sets the width to the current path.

## ApiPathCommand

- [ApiPathCommand](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPathCommand.md): Class representing a path command.
- [ApiPathCommand.GetHR](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPathCommand/Methods/GetHR.md): Returns the height radius of the arc.
- [ApiPathCommand.GetStartAngle](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPathCommand/Methods/GetStartAngle.md): Returns the start angle of the arc.
- [ApiPathCommand.GetSweepAngle](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPathCommand/Methods/GetSweepAngle.md): Returns the sweep angle of the arc.
- [ApiPathCommand.GetType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPathCommand/Methods/GetType.md): Returns the type of the current path command.
- [ApiPathCommand.GetWR](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPathCommand/Methods/GetWR.md): Returns the width radius of the arc.
- [ApiPathCommand.GetX](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPathCommand/Methods/GetX.md): Returns the X coordinate for the "moveTo"/"lineTo" path commands.
- [ApiPathCommand.GetX0](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPathCommand/Methods/GetX0.md): Returns the X coordinate of the first control point for the Bezier curves.
- [ApiPathCommand.GetX1](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPathCommand/Methods/GetX1.md): Returns the X coordinate of the second control point for the cubic Bezier curves.
- [ApiPathCommand.GetX2](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPathCommand/Methods/GetX2.md): Returns the X coordinate of the end point for the cubic Bezier curves.
- [ApiPathCommand.GetY](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPathCommand/Methods/GetY.md): Returns the Y coordinate for the "moveTo"/"lineTo" path commands.
- [ApiPathCommand.GetY0](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPathCommand/Methods/GetY0.md): Returns the Y coordinate of the first control point for the Bezier curves.
- [ApiPathCommand.GetY1](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPathCommand/Methods/GetY1.md): Returns the Y coordinate of the second control point for the cubic Bezier curves.
- [ApiPathCommand.GetY2](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPathCommand/Methods/GetY2.md): Returns the Y coordinate of the end point for the cubic Bezier curves.

## ApiPivotDataField

- [ApiPivotDataField](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField.md): Class representing a pivot table data field.
- [ApiPivotDataField.AutoSort](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/AutoSort.md): Establishes automatic field-sorting rules for the pivot table reports.
- [ApiPivotDataField.ClearAllFilters](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/ClearAllFilters.md): Deletes all filters currently applied to the pivot field.
- [ApiPivotDataField.ClearLabelFilters](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/ClearLabelFilters.md): Deletes all label filters or all date filters from the pivot filters collection.
- [ApiPivotDataField.ClearManualFilters](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/ClearManualFilters.md): Deletes all manual filters from the pivot filters collection.
- [ApiPivotDataField.ClearValueFilters](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/ClearValueFilters.md): Deletes all value filters from the pivot filters collection.
- [ApiPivotDataField.GetCaption](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/GetCaption.md): Returns a value that represents the label text for the data field.
- [ApiPivotDataField.GetCurrentPage](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/GetCurrentPage.md): Returns the current page which is displayed for the page field (valid only for page fields).
- [ApiPivotDataField.GetDragToColumn](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/GetDragToColumn.md): Returns the setting which specifies whether the specified field can be dragged to the column position.
- [ApiPivotDataField.GetDragToData](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/GetDragToData.md): Returns the setting which specifies whether the specified field can be dragged to the data position.
- [ApiPivotDataField.GetDragToPage](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/GetDragToPage.md): Returns the setting which specifies whether the specified field can be dragged to the page position.
- [ApiPivotDataField.GetDragToRow](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/GetDragToRow.md): Returns the setting which specifies whether the specified field can be dragged to the row position.
- [ApiPivotDataField.GetFunction](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/GetFunction.md): Returns a function performed in the data field.
- [ApiPivotDataField.GetIndex](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/GetIndex.md): Returns an index of the data field.
- [ApiPivotDataField.GetLayoutBlankLine](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/GetLayoutBlankLine.md): Returns the setting which specifies whether to insert blank rows after each item.
- [ApiPivotDataField.GetLayoutCompactRow](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/GetLayoutCompactRow.md): Returns the setting which specifies whether a pivot table field is compacted.
- [ApiPivotDataField.GetLayoutForm](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/GetLayoutForm.md): Returns the way the specified pivot table items appear — in table format or in outline format.
- [ApiPivotDataField.GetLayoutPageBreak](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/GetLayoutPageBreak.md): Returns the setting which specifies whether to insert a page break after each field.
- [ApiPivotDataField.GetLayoutSubtotalLocation](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/GetLayoutSubtotalLocation.md): Returns the layout subtotal location.
- [ApiPivotDataField.GetLayoutSubtotals](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/GetLayoutSubtotals.md): Returns the setting which specifies whether to show subtotals.
- [ApiPivotDataField.GetName](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/GetName.md): Returns a value representing the object name.
- [ApiPivotDataField.GetNumberFormat](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/GetNumberFormat.md): Returns a value that represents the format code for the object.
- [ApiPivotDataField.GetOrientation](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/GetOrientation.md): Returns a data field orientation value that represents the data field location in the specified pivot table report.
- [ApiPivotDataField.GetParent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/GetParent.md): Returns the parent object for the current field.
- [ApiPivotDataField.GetPivotField](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/GetPivotField.md): Returns the pivot field from which the data field was created.
- [ApiPivotDataField.GetPivotFilters](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/GetPivotFilters.md): Returns the collection of pivot filters applied to the specified pivot field.
- [ApiPivotDataField.GetPivotItems](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/GetPivotItems.md): Returns an object that represents either a single pivot table item (the ApiPivotItem object) or a collection of all the visible and hidden items (an array of the ApiPivotItem objects) in the specified field.
- [ApiPivotDataField.GetPosition](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/GetPosition.md): Returns a value that represents the data field position within a category.
- [ApiPivotDataField.GetRepeatLabels](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/GetRepeatLabels.md): Returns the setting which specifies whether to repeat items labels at each row.
- [ApiPivotDataField.GetShowAllItems](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/GetShowAllItems.md): Returns the setting which specifies whether to show items with no data.
- [ApiPivotDataField.GetShowingInAxis](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/GetShowingInAxis.md): Returns the setting which specifies whether the pivot table field is currently visible in the pivot table.
- [ApiPivotDataField.GetSourceName](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/GetSourceName.md): Returns a source name for the pivot table field.
- [ApiPivotDataField.GetSubtotalName](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/GetSubtotalName.md): Returns the text label displayed in the subtotal column or row heading in the specified pivot table report.
- [ApiPivotDataField.GetSubtotals](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/GetSubtotals.md): Returns an object that represents all subtotals.
- [ApiPivotDataField.GetTable](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/GetTable.md): Returns the ApiPivotTable object which represents the pivot table for the current field.
- [ApiPivotDataField.GetValue](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/GetValue.md): Returns a value representing the name of the specified data field in the pivot table report.
- [ApiPivotDataField.Group](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/Group.md): Groups the dates of the pivot table field by periods or its numbers by intervals, as VBA Range.Group does for a cell of the field. The field must be in the rows or columns; grouping again replaces the previous grouping of the field. For dates, the field shows the shortest period, and a new field is added next to it for every longer one.
- [ApiPivotDataField.Move](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/Move.md): Moves the current data field inside the category.
- [ApiPivotDataField.Remove](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/Remove.md): Removes the current data field from the category.
- [ApiPivotDataField.SetCaption](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/SetCaption.md): Sets a value that represents the label text for the data field.
- [ApiPivotDataField.SetDragToColumn](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/SetDragToColumn.md): Sets the setting which specifies whether the specified field can be dragged to the column position.
- [ApiPivotDataField.SetDragToData](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/SetDragToData.md): Sets the setting which specifies whether the specified field can be dragged to the data position.
- [ApiPivotDataField.SetDragToPage](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/SetDragToPage.md): Sets the setting which specifies whether the specified field can be dragged to the page position.
- [ApiPivotDataField.SetDragToRow](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/SetDragToRow.md): Sets the setting which specifies whether the specified field can be dragged to the row position.
- [ApiPivotDataField.SetFunction](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/SetFunction.md): Sets a function to the current data field.
- [ApiPivotDataField.SetLayoutBlankLine](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/SetLayoutBlankLine.md): Sets the setting which specifies whether to insert blank rows after each item.

- [ApiPivotDataField.SetLayoutSubtotalLocation](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiPivotDataField/Methods/SetLayoutSubtotalLocation.md): Sets the layout subtotal location.

## ApiRange

- [ApiRange](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiRange.md): Class representing a range.
- [ApiRange.AddComment](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiRange/Methods/AddComment.md): Adds a comment to the current range.
- [ApiRange.AutoFit](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiRange/Methods/AutoFit.md): Changes the width of the columns or the height of the rows in the range to achieve the best fit.
- [ApiRange.Clear](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiRange/Methods/Clear.md): Clears the current range.
- [ApiRange.ClearContents](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiRange/Methods/ClearContents.md): Clears all contents from the current range.
- [ApiRange.ClearFormats](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiRange/Methods/ClearFormats.md): Clears all formatting from the current range.
- [ApiRange.ClearHyperlinks](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiRange/Methods/ClearHyperlinks.md): Clears all hyperlinks from the current range.
- [ApiRange.Copy](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiRange/Methods/Copy.md): Copies the range to the specified range or to the clipboard.
- [ApiRange.Cut](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiRange/Methods/Cut.md): Cuts the range and save it to the clipboard or paste it to the specified range.
- [ApiRange.Delete](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiRange/Methods/Delete.md): Deletes the Range object.
- [ApiRange.End](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiRange/Methods/End.md): Returns a Range object that represents the end in the specified direction in the specified range.
- [ApiRange.FillDown](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiRange/Methods/FillDown.md): Copies the contents and formatting of the top row of the range into the remaining rows.
- [ApiRange.FillLeft](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiRange/Methods/FillLeft.md): Copies the contents and formatting of the rightmost column of the range into the remaining columns.
- [ApiRange.FillRight](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiRange/Methods/FillRight.md): Copies the contents and formatting of the leftmost column of the range into the remaining columns.
- [ApiRange.FillUp](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiRange/Methods/FillUp.md): Copies the contents and formatting of the bottom row of the range into the remaining rows.
- [ApiRange.Find](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiRange/Methods/Find.md): Finds specific information in the current range.
- [ApiRange.FindNext](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiRange/Methods/FindNext.md): Continues a search that was begun with the ApiRange#Find method. Finds the next cell that matches those same conditions and returns the ApiRange object that represents that cell.
- [ApiRange.FindPrevious](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiRange/Methods/FindPrevious.md): Continues a search that was begun with the ApiRange#Find method. Finds the previous cell that matches those same conditions and returns the ApiRange object that represents that cell.
- [ApiRange.ForEach](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiRange/Methods/ForEach.md): Executes a provided function once for each cell.

- [ApiRange.RemoveDuplicates](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiRange/Methods/RemoveDuplicates.md): Removes the rows with duplicate values from the range, as the Remove Duplicates command does. A range inside a table stands for the whole table, and the autofilter range or one cell of it stands for the filtered range. Rows are duplicates when the displayed values of the compared columns are equal, case-insensitively; the first of them is kept. The other rows of the range move up in place of the removed ones; the cells outside the range stay in place.

- [ApiRun.SetFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiRun/Methods/SetFill.md): Sets the text color to the current text run.

- [ApiRun.SetFontSize](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiRun/Methods/SetFontSize.md): Sets the font size to the characters of the current text run.
- [ApiRun.SetItalic](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiRun/Methods/SetItalic.md): Sets the italic property to the text character.

- [ApiRun.SetSpacing](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiRun/Methods/SetSpacing.md): Sets the text spacing measured in twentieths of a point.
