## ApiShadow

- [ApiShadow](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShadow.md): Class representing a shadow.
- [ApiShadow.GetClassType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShadow/Methods/GetClassType.md): Returns a type of the ApiShadow class.
- [ApiShadow.GetSettings](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShadow/Methods/GetSettings.md): Returns the settings of the current shadow.

## ApiShape

- [ApiShape](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape.md): Class representing a shape.
- [ApiShape.Copy](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/Copy.md): Creates a copy of the current shape.
- [ApiShape.Delete](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/Delete.md): Deletes the specified drawing object.
- [ApiShape.Fill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/Fill.md): Sets the fill formatting properties to the current graphic object.
- [ApiShape.GetClassType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/GetClassType.md): Returns a type of the ApiShape class.
- [ApiShape.GetContent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/GetContent.md): Returns the shape inner contents where a paragraph or text runs can be inserted.
- [ApiShape.GetDescription](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/GetDescription.md): Gets the description of the current drawing.
- [ApiShape.GetDocContent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/GetDocContent.md): Returns the shape inner contents where a paragraph or text runs can be inserted.
- [ApiShape.GetFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/GetFill.md): Gets the fill formatting properties from the current graphic object.
- [ApiShape.GetFlipH](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/GetFlipH.md): Get horizontal flip of current drawing.
- [ApiShape.GetFlipV](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/GetFlipV.md): Get vertical flip of current drawing.
- [ApiShape.GetGeometry](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/GetGeometry.md): Returns the geometry object from the current shape.
- [ApiShape.GetHeight](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/GetHeight.md): Returns the height of the current drawing.
- [ApiShape.GetInternalId](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/GetInternalId.md): Returns an internal ID of the current drawing object.
- [ApiShape.GetLine](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/GetLine.md): Gets the outline properties from the current shape.
- [ApiShape.GetLockAspect](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/GetLockAspect.md): Returns whether the aspect ratio of the drawing is locked.
- [ApiShape.GetLockValue](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/GetLockValue.md): Returns the lock value for the specified lock type of the current drawing.
- [ApiShape.GetName](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/GetName.md): Returns the name of the current drawing.
- [ApiShape.GetParentSheet](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/GetParentSheet.md): Returns the parent sheet of the current drawing.
- [ApiShape.GetPosX](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/GetPosX.md): Returns the x position of the current drawing on the worksheet.
- [ApiShape.GetPosY](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/GetPosY.md): Returns the y position of the current drawing on the worksheet.
- [ApiShape.GetPosition](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/GetPosition.md): Returns the cell anchor of the current drawing; the offsets are limited by the anchor cell.
- [ApiShape.GetRotation](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/GetRotation.md): Returns the rotation angle of the current drawing object.
- [ApiShape.GetShadow](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/GetShadow.md): Returns the shadow of the current graphic object.
- [ApiShape.GetTextRange](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/GetTextRange.md): Returns a text range that covers the whole text of the current drawing. Creates a text body if the drawing does not yet have one.
- [ApiShape.GetTitle](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/GetTitle.md): Gets the title of the current drawing.
- [ApiShape.GetVerticalTextAlign](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/GetVerticalTextAlign.md): Gets the vertical alignment from the shape content where a paragraph or text runs can be inserted.
- [ApiShape.GetWidth](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/GetWidth.md): Returns the width of the current drawing.
- [ApiShape.HasTextContent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/HasTextContent.md): Checks whether the current drawing has a text body.
- [ApiShape.Select](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/Select.md): Selects the current graphic object.
- [ApiShape.SetDescription](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/SetDescription.md): Sets the description of the current drawing.
- [ApiShape.SetFill](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/SetFill.md): Sets the fill formatting properties to the current graphic object.
- [ApiShape.SetFlipH](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/SetFlipH.md): Sets the horizontal flip of the current drawing.
- [ApiShape.SetFlipV](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/SetFlipV.md): Sets the vertical flip of the current drawing.
- [ApiShape.SetGeometry](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/SetGeometry.md): Sets a custom geometry for the current shape.
- [ApiShape.SetLine](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/SetLine.md): Sets the outline properties to the current shape.
- [ApiShape.SetLockAspect](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/SetLockAspect.md): Sets whether the aspect ratio of the drawing is locked.
- [ApiShape.SetLockValue](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/SetLockValue.md): Sets the lock value to the specified lock type of the current drawing.
- [ApiShape.SetName](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/SetName.md): Sets the name of the current drawing.
- [ApiShape.SetOutLine](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/SetOutLine.md): Sets the outline properties to the specified graphic object.
- [ApiShape.SetPaddings](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/SetPaddings.md): Sets the text paddings to the current shape.
- [ApiShape.SetPosition](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/SetPosition.md): Changes the position for the drawing object.
- [ApiShape.SetRotation](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/SetRotation.md): Sets the rotation angle to the current drawing object.
- [ApiShape.SetShadow](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/SetShadow.md): Sets the shadow to the current graphic object.
- [ApiShape.SetSize](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/SetSize.md): Sets a size of the object (image, shape, chart) bounding box.
- [ApiShape.SetTitle](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/SetTitle.md): Sets the title of the current drawing.
- [ApiShape.SetVerticalTextAlign](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/SetVerticalTextAlign.md): Sets the vertical alignment to the shape content where a paragraph or text runs can be inserted.
- [ApiShape.Unselect](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiShape/Methods/Unselect.md): Removes the current drawing from the selection.

## ApiSort

- [ApiSort](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiSort.md): Class representing the sort state of a list object (table).
- [ApiSort.Apply](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiSort/Methods/Apply.md): Applies the current sort settings to the table.
- [ApiSort.GetHeader](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiSort/Methods/GetHeader.md): Returns the header setting.
- [ApiSort.GetMatchCase](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiSort/Methods/GetMatchCase.md): Returns whether the sort is case-sensitive.
- [ApiSort.GetOrientation](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiSort/Methods/GetOrientation.md): Returns the sort orientation: "xlTopToBottom" or "xlLeftToRight".
- [ApiSort.GetParent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiSort/Methods/GetParent.md): Returns the parent list object.
- [ApiSort.GetRng](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiSort/Methods/GetRng.md): Returns the data body range that the sort applies to.
- [ApiSort.GetSortFields](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiSort/Methods/GetSortFields.md): Returns the sort fields collection.
- [ApiSort.GetSortMethod](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiSort/Methods/GetSortMethod.md): Returns the sort method: "xlPinYin" or "xlStroke".
- [ApiSort.SetMatchCase](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiSort/Methods/SetMatchCase.md): Sets whether the sort is case-sensitive.
- [ApiSort.SetOrientation](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiSort/Methods/SetOrientation.md): Sets the sort orientation.
- [ApiSort.SetSortMethod](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiSort/Methods/SetSortMethod.md): Sets the sort method.

## ApiSortField

- [ApiSortField](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiSortField.md): Class representing a single sort field within a SortFields collection.
- [ApiSortField.Delete](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiSortField/Methods/Delete.md): Removes this sort field from the collection.
- [ApiSortField.GetKey](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiSortField/Methods/GetKey.md): Returns the sort key range (the full table column).
- [ApiSortField.GetOrder](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiSortField/Methods/GetOrder.md): Returns the sort order: "xlAscending" or "xlDescending".
- [ApiSortField.GetParent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiSortField/Methods/GetParent.md): Returns the parent SortFields collection.
- [ApiSortField.GetPriority](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiSortField/Methods/GetPriority.md): Returns the 1-based priority of this sort field within the collection.
- [ApiSortField.GetSortOn](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiSortField/Methods/GetSortOn.md): Returns the sort-on type: "xlSortOnValues", "xlSortOnCellColor", "xlSortOnFontColor", "xlSortOnIcon".
- [ApiSortField.GetSortOnValue](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiSortField/Methods/GetSortOnValue.md): Returns the value (color or null) by which this sort field is sorted.
- [ApiSortField.ModifyKey](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiSortField/Methods/ModifyKey.md): Changes the sort key column.
- [ApiSortField.SetOrder](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiSortField/Methods/SetOrder.md): Sets the sort order.
- [ApiSortField.SetPriority](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiSortField/Methods/SetPriority.md): Sets the 1-based priority of this sort field, repositioning it within the collection.
- [ApiSortField.SetSortOn](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiSortField/Methods/SetSortOn.md): Sets the sort-on type.
- [ApiSortField.SetSortOnColor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiSortField/Methods/SetSortOnColor.md): Sets the color for color-based sorting.

## ApiSortFields

- [ApiSortFields](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiSortFields.md): Class representing the collection of sort fields for a Sort object.
- [ApiSortFields.Add](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiSortFields/Methods/Add.md): Adds a sort field to the collection.
- [ApiSortFields.Add2](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiSortFields/Methods/Add2.md): Adds a sort field with subfield support for linked data types (Stocks, Geography).
- [ApiSortFields.Clear](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiSortFields/Methods/Clear.md): Removes all sort fields from the collection.
- [ApiSortFields.GetCount](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiSortFields/Methods/GetCount.md): Returns the number of sort fields.
- [ApiSortFields.GetParent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiSortFields/Methods/GetParent.md): Returns the parent Sort object.

- [ApiTextPr.SetSpacing](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTextPr/Methods/SetSpacing.md): Sets the text spacing measured in twentieths of a point.

## ApiTextRange

- [ApiTextRange](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTextRange.md): Class representing a text range within a presentation shape's text frame.
- [ApiTextRange.AddHyperlink](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/AddHyperlink.md): Adds a hyperlink to the current text range.
- [ApiTextRange.AddText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/AddText.md): Adds a text to the specified position. The current range is expanded to include the added text.
- [ApiTextRange.Delete](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/Delete.md): Deletes the contents of the current text range.
- [ApiTextRange.ExpandTo](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/ExpandTo.md): Returns a new range that spans both this range and the given range. The current range is not changed.
- [ApiTextRange.Find](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/Find.md): Finds the first occurrence of the given text within this range and returns it as a new ApiTextRange. Returns null if the text is not found.
- [ApiTextRange.GetAllParagraphs](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/GetAllParagraphs.md): Returns all Paragraph objects within this range.

- [ApiTextRange.GetEndPos](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/GetEndPos.md): Returns the end position of the current range.
- [ApiTextRange.GetParagraph](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/GetParagraph.md): Returns the paragraph at the given index within this range. Returns null if the index is out of bounds.

- [ApiTextRange.GetText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/GetText.md): Returns the text content of the range. Paragraph breaks are represented as "\r".

- [ApiTextRange.IntersectWith](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/IntersectWith.md): Returns a new range that is the intersection of this range and the given range. The current range is not changed.
- [ApiTextRange.MoveCursorToPos](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/MoveCursorToPos.md): Moves a cursor to the specified position within the current range.
- [ApiTextRange.Replace](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/Replace.md): Replaces all occurrences of the specified text within this range.
- [ApiTextRange.Select](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/Select.md): Selects the text range in the editor.
- [ApiTextRange.SetBold](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetBold.md): Sets bold formatting for the contents of the current text range.
- [ApiTextRange.SetCaps](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetCaps.md): Specifies that any lowercase characters in the current text Range are formatted for display only as their capital letter character equivalents.

- [ApiTextRange.SetEndPos](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetEndPos.md): Sets the end position of the current range.
- [ApiTextRange.SetFontFamily](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetFontFamily.md): Sets the font family for the current TextRange.
- [ApiTextRange.SetFontSize](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetFontSize.md): Sets the font size of the characters in the current text Range.
- [ApiTextRange.SetHighlight](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetHighlight.md): Specifies a highlighting color which is applied as a background to the contents of the current Range.
- [ApiTextRange.SetItalic](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetItalic.md): Sets the italic property to the text character.
- [ApiTextRange.SetLanguage](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetLanguage.md): Specifies the language which will be used to check spelling and grammar (if requested) when processing the contents of the current text range.
- [ApiTextRange.SetSmallCaps](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetSmallCaps.md): Specifies that all the lowercase letter characters in the current text Range are formatted for display only as their capital letter character equivalents which are two points smaller than the actual font size specified for this text.
- [ApiTextRange.SetSpacing](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetSpacing.md): Sets the text spacing measured in twentieths of a point.
- [ApiTextRange.SetStartPos](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetStartPos.md): Sets the start position of the current range.
- [ApiTextRange.SetStrikeout](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetStrikeout.md): Specifies that the contents of the current Range are displayed with a single horizontal line through the range center.
- [ApiTextRange.SetText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetText.md): Replaces all text content with the given string. Use "\r" to separate paragraphs.
- [ApiTextRange.SetTextPr](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetTextPr.md): Sets the text properties to the current text range.
- [ApiTextRange.SetUnderline](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetUnderline.md): Specifies that the contents of the current Range are displayed along with a line appearing directly below the character (less than all the spacing above and below the characters on the line).
- [ApiTextRange.SetVertAlign](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/SetVertAlign.md): Specifies the alignment which will be applied to the Range contents in relation to the default appearance of the Range text: "baseline" - the characters in the current text Range will be aligned by the default text baseline. "subscript" - the characters in the current text Range will be aligned below the default text baseline. "superscript" - the characters in the current text Range will be aligned above the default text baseline.
- [ApiTextRange.ToHtml](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTextRange/Methods/ToHtml.md): Converts the text range to HTML.

- [ApiTop10.SetNumberFormat](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTop10/Methods/SetNumberFormat.md): Sets the number format for the top 10 conditional formatting rule.

- [ApiTop10.SetPriority](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTop10/Methods/SetPriority.md): Sets the priority value for the conditional formatting rule.
- [ApiTop10.SetRank](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTop10/Methods/SetRank.md): Sets the rank value for the top 10 condition.
- [ApiTop10.SetScopeType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTop10/Methods/SetScopeType.md): Sets the scope type for the conditional formatting rule.
- [ApiTop10.SetStopIfTrue](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTop10/Methods/SetStopIfTrue.md): Sets whether the editor will stop evaluating additional formatting rules if this rule evaluates to true.
- [ApiTop10.SetText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTop10/Methods/SetText.md): Sets the text value used in text-based conditional formatting rules.
- [ApiTop10.SetTextOperator](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTop10/Methods/SetTextOperator.md): Sets the text operator for text-based conditional formatting rules.
- [ApiTop10.SetTopBottom](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiTop10/Methods/SetTopBottom.md): Sets the "XlTopBottom" constant indicating whether the ranking is evaluated from the top or bottom.

## ApiWorkbook

- [ApiWorkbook](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorkbook.md): Class representing the currently active workbook
- [ApiWorkbook.BreakLink](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorkbook/Methods/BreakLink.md): Breaks the link to the specified workbook: the formulas that refer to it are replaced with their current values, and the link is removed from the workbook.
- [ApiWorkbook.Calculate](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorkbook/Methods/Calculate.md): Recalculates the cells that need recalculation (changed, added or volatile) across the workbook. Forces the recalc that is otherwise deferred until a macro finishes, so up-to-date formula results can be read within the same macro.
- [ApiWorkbook.GetActiveChart](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorkbook/Methods/GetActiveChart.md): Returns the active chart of the workbook.
- [ApiWorkbook.GetActiveSheet](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorkbook/Methods/GetActiveSheet.md): Returns the active sheet of the workbook.
- [ApiWorkbook.GetAllPivotTables](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorkbook/Methods/GetAllPivotTables.md): Returns all pivot tables in the workbook.
- [ApiWorkbook.GetCustomProperties](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorkbook/Methods/GetCustomProperties.md): Returns the custom properties of the workbook.
- [ApiWorkbook.GetDrawingsByName](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorkbook/Methods/GetDrawingsByName.md): Returns drawings with the specified names from the workbook.
- [ApiWorkbook.GetLinkSources](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorkbook/Methods/GetLinkSources.md): Returns the paths of the other workbooks registered as external links of the current workbook, including links no formula uses any longer.
- [ApiWorkbook.GetName](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorkbook/Methods/GetName.md): Returns the name of the workbook.
- [ApiWorkbook.GetSheets](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorkbook/Methods/GetSheets.md): Returns a sheet collection that represents all the sheets in the workbook.
- [ApiWorkbook.GetTheme](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorkbook/Methods/GetTheme.md): Returns the theme of the workbook.
- [ApiWorkbook.Redraw](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorkbook/Methods/Redraw.md): Redraws the editor screen, making the changes already made by a macro visible without waiting for it to finish. Observable from asynchronous code only. Repaints without recalculating: call ApiWorkbook#Calculate first if formula results must be up to date.
- [ApiWorkbook.Save](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorkbook/Methods/Save.md): Saves changes to the specified document.

## ApiWorksheetFunction

- [ApiWorksheetFunction](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction.md): Class representing a worksheet function.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.ABS](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/ABS.md): Returns the absolute value of a number, a number without its sign.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.ACCRINT](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/ACCRINT.md): Returns the accrued interest for a security that pays periodic interest.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.ACCRINTM](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/ACCRINTM.md): Returns the accrued interest for a security that pays interest at maturity.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.ACOS](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/ACOS.md): Returns the arccosine of a number, in radians in the range from 0 to Pi.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.ACOSH](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/ACOSH.md): Returns the inverse hyperbolic cosine of a number.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.ACOT](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/ACOT.md): Returns the arccotangent of a number, in radians in the range from 0 to Pi.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.ACOTH](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/ACOTH.md): Returns the inverse hyperbolic cotangent of a number.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.AGGREGATE](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/AGGREGATE.md): Returns an aggregate in a list or database.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.AMORDEGRC](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/AMORDEGRC.md): Returns the prorated linear depreciation of an asset for each accounting period.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.AMORLINC](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/AMORLINC.md): Returns the prorated linear depreciation of an asset for each accounting period.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.AND](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/AND.md): Checks whether all conditions in a test are true.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.ARABIC](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/ARABIC.md): Converts a Roman numeral to Arabic.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.ASC](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/ASC.md): For double-byte character set (DBCS) languages, the function changes full-width (double-byte) characters to half-width (single-byte) characters.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.ASIN](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/ASIN.md): Returns the arcsine of a number in radians, in the range from -Pi/2 to Pi/2.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.ASINH](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/ASINH.md): Returns the inverse hyperbolic sine of a number.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.ATAN](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/ATAN.md): Returns the arctangent of a number in radians, in the range from -Pi/2 to Pi/2.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.ATAN2](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/ATAN2.md): Returns the arctangent of the specified x and y coordinates, in radians between -Pi and Pi, excluding -Pi.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.ATANH](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/ATANH.md): Returns the inverse hyperbolic tangent of a number.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.AVEDEV](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/AVEDEV.md): Returns the average of the absolute deviations of data points from their mean.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.AVERAGE](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/AVERAGE.md): Returns the average (arithmetic mean) of the specified arguments.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.AVERAGEA](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/AVERAGEA.md): Returns the average (arithmetic mean) of the specified arguments, evaluating text and false in arguments as 0; true evaluates as 1.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.AVERAGEIF](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/AVERAGEIF.md): Finds the average (arithmetic mean) for the cells specified by a given condition or criteria.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.AVERAGEIFS](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/AVERAGEIFS.md): Finds the average (arithmetic mean) for the cells specified by a given set of conditions or criteria.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.BASE](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/BASE.md): Converts a number into a text representation with the given radix (base).
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.BESSELI](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/BESSELI.md): Returns the modified Bessel function In(x).
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.BESSELJ](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/BESSELJ.md): Returns the Bessel function Jn(x).
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.BESSELK](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/BESSELK.md): Returns the modified Bessel function Kn(x).

- [ApiWorksheetFunction.BETAINV](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/BETAINV.md): Returns the inverse of the cumulative beta probability density function for a specified beta distribution (BETADIST).
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.BETA_DIST](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/BETA_DIST.md): Returns the beta probability distribution function.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.BETA_INV](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/BETA_INV.md): Returns the inverse of the cumulative beta probability density function (BETA_DIST).
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.BIN2DEC](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/BIN2DEC.md): Converts a binary number to decimal.

- [ApiWorksheetFunction.BINOM_DIST](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/BINOM_DIST.md): Returns the individual term binomial distribution probability.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.BINOM_DIST_RANGE](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/BINOM_DIST_RANGE.md): Returns the probability of a trial result using a binomial distribution.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.BINOM_INV](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/BINOM_INV.md): Returns the smallest value for which the cumulative binomial distribution is greater than or equal to a criterion value.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.BITAND](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/BITAND.md): Returns a bitwise "AND" of two numbers.

The number is always rounded up regardless of its sign.

- [ApiWorksheetFunction.VAR_P](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/VAR_P.md): Calculates variance based on the entire population (ignores logical values and text in the population).
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.VAR_S](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/VAR_S.md): Estimates variance based on a sample (ignores logical values and text in the sample).
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.VDB](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/VDB.md): Returns the depreciation of an asset for any specified period, including partial periods, using the double-declining balance method or some other method specified.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.VLOOKUP](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/VLOOKUP.md): Looks for a value in the leftmost column of a table and then returns a value in the same row from the specified column.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.WEEKDAY](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/WEEKDAY.md): Returns a number from 1 to 7 identifying the day of the week of the specified date.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.WEEKNUM](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/WEEKNUM.md): Returns the week number in the year.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.WEIBULL](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/WEIBULL.md): Returns the Weibull distribution.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.WEIBULL_DIST](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/WEIBULL_DIST.md): Returns the Weibull distribution.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.WORKDAY](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/WORKDAY.md): Returns the serial number of the date before or after a specified number of workdays.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.WORKDAY_INTL](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/WORKDAY_INTL.md): Returns the serial number of the date before or after a specified number of workdays with custom weekend parameters.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.XIRR](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/XIRR.md): Returns the internal rate of return for a schedule of cash flows.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.XNPV](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/XNPV.md): Returns the net present value for a schedule of cash flows.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.XOR](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/XOR.md): Returns the logical Exclusive Or value of all arguments.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.YEAR](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/YEAR.md): Returns the year of a date, an integer in the range 1900-9999.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.YEARFRAC](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/YEARFRAC.md): Returns the year fraction representing the number of whole days between the start date and end date.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.YIELD](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/YIELD.md): Returns the yield on a security that pays periodic interest.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.YIELDDISC](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/YIELDDISC.md): Returns the annual yield for a discounted security.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.YIELDMAT](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/YIELDMAT.md): Returns the annual yield of a security that pays interest at maturity.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.ZTEST](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/ZTEST.md): Returns the one-tailed P-value of a z-test.
- [ApiWorksheetFunction.Z_TEST](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/ApiWorksheetFunction/Methods/Z_TEST.md): Returns the one-tailed P-value of a z-test.

## Enumeration

- [Angle](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Enumeration/Angle.md): Specifies the range angle.

- [ChartType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/office-api/usage-api/spreadsheet-api/Enumeration/ChartType.md): This type specifies the available chart types which can be used to create a new chart.
